title: Longest Window with K Distinct
prompt:
Implement `static int longestWindow(int[] xs, int k)` — the length
of the longest contiguous run containing at most k distinct values.
k <= 0 → 0. Use the sliding-window pattern with a frequency map.

[1,2,1,2,3], k=2 → 4 (the run [1,2,1,2]).
[1,1,1], k=1 → 3. Empty → 0.

tests.name: window shrinks on overflow
tests.hint: The 3 forces a shrink; best is the earlier 4-length run.

tests.name: single value
tests.hint: One distinct value, whole array qualifies.
